# New-ZbxHistoryValue

## SYNOPSIS

Builds one value for the history data of a proxy data request.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxHistoryValue [-ItemId] <ulong> [-Value] <string> [-Clock <DateTimeOffset>] [-Ns <int>] [-Id <long>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The New-ZbxHistoryValue cmdlet writes one ZabbixProxyHistoryItem: the item's id, the value as text, its clock (now when -Clock is not given) and a sequence id the server removes duplicates by. It is one entry of the history data a proxy sends, for New-ZbxProxyData, Send-ZbxProxyData or a data provider's page. -ItemId, -Value and -Clock bind by property name, so items piped from Get-ZbxItem give their own ids. Nothing is sent to the server.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Build a value for an item

```powershell
$item = Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Requests'
New-ZbxHistoryValue -ItemId $item.ItemId -Value '42'
```

The id is the item's; the clock is now.

### Example 2: Build a minute of values with past clocks

```powershell
$item = Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Requests'
$start = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(-1).ToUnixTimeSeconds()
0..5 | ForEach-Object { New-ZbxHistoryValue -ItemId $item.ItemId -Value (10 * $_) -Clock ($start + 10 * $_) } | Select-Object ItemId, Clock, Value
```

-Clock takes a date, Unix seconds or a clock; each value gets the next sequence id.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixProxyHistoryItem`: One value as proxy data carries it: by item id, with its id — the store's sequence, which the server de-duplicates on — and its state.
